scope: Homepage and all public page templates; all 22 project and five writing detail routes
status: Identified layout defects fixed and locally verified. Not deployed.

issues.problem: Headline and supporting copy collide at wide, short viewport sizes.
issues.fix: Replaced absolute positioning with normal grid flow and an independently sized copy column.

issues.problem: Competing hero definitions across six stylesheets produce inconsistent breakpoint behavior.
issues.fix: Removed old hero rules and consolidated the opening into one stylesheet.

issues.problem: Sculpture and captions intrude on the footer actions.
issues.fix: Reserved separate artwork and action grid rows; removed the pinned hero transformation.

issues.problem: Animated letter entrances can cross supporting text before settling.
issues.fix: Confined entrance movement to the headline line boxes.

issues.problem: Mobile and desktop frames crop the wide website screenshots differently.
issues.fix: Used consistent 2.06:1 frames with contain fitting, retaining the complete image.

issues.problem: Parallax zoom hides part of each website preview even when the frame ratio is correct.
issues.fix: Removed image scale and horizontal parallax; preserved the scrollable work reel.

issues.problem: Large cards can crowd headings and captions on shorter desktops.
issues.fix: Bound card width to viewport height and reserved readable caption rows.

issues.problem: Near-square archive covers crop wide screenshots; hover zoom compounds the crop.
issues.fix: Standardized frame proportions, contained images, and removed preview zoom and tilt.

issues.problem: Status badges cover useful image content.
issues.fix: Moved badges into the project caption below the preview.

issues.problem: Placeholder min-height and aspect ratio expand cards past the page; long names clip.
issues.fix: Bound media width, removed the conflicting minimum height, and scaled placeholder type to its container.

issues.problem: Seven typographic project covers overflow on 320 px screens.
issues.fix: Allowed long titles to wrap and placed the decorative arrow on its own line.

issues.problem: Long job names compete with a fixed date column; inactive roles are unnecessarily faded.
issues.fix: Placed dates below role content and kept all role descriptions legible.

issues.problem: The pointer-following cover can obscure long article titles.
issues.fix: Removed the decorative overlay on the homepage writing index; preserved row interactions.

issues.problem: Author, organisation and date compete for a narrow card footer.
issues.fix: Placed the date on a separate line and constrained mobile card widths.

issues.problem: Contact and scheduling columns become cramped on tablets; large headings and links overflow.
issues.fix: Stacked form layouts earlier, scaled headings, separated contact links and enlarged readable labels.

issues.problem: Tiny supporting text, inconsistent gutters and small controls weaken readability and touch use.
issues.fix: Unified gutters; raised supporting type sizes; improved menu, footer and form control targets.

issues.problem: Every original image is advertised as 1600 px wide, including the 1100 px hero.
issues.fix: Generated actual source dimensions for srcset descriptors; refreshed variants when sources change.

issues.problem: Next normalizes the request URL host, rejecting valid same-origin submissions from the local IP alias.
issues.fix: Validated Origin against the request destination Host and protocol, while retaining cross-origin rejection.

issues.problem: The old verification script expects removed routes and writes submission data by default.
issues.fix: Updated routes and redirects, checked internal links and assets, and made test submissions explicitly opt-in.

verification.heroResult: No page overflow or intersecting copy, artwork and footer at all seven sizes
interactions: Reduced-motion preference removes pins and survives reload
verification.submissionTests: Contact, review, call preference, idempotency, eight validation/security cases, and both localhost aliases passed against an isolated local database

remaining: Production deployment has not been performed.
The default development checkout has no submission database configured. Submission tests used a disposable local database; live persistence needs the deployment's database connection.
External service availability and owner-supplied factual content were not certified by this layout audit.
